report:
The complete original P16.5 is not established. Relative to the exact task-granted ample theorem G0, the supplied argument supports its prescribed-divisorial-reference theorem throughout the full big rational-line-bundle first target. I found no fatal mathematical defect in that theorem or in the effective-divisor zero-mass extension. The author's native candidate=false and three unresolved scope statements remain preserved; neither the historical FAIL108 nor documentary bindings determine this verdict.

The retained domain is every algebraically closed, trivially valued characteristic-zero field, every smooth integral projective original X of dimension n≥1, and every actual big rational line bundle L. The datum L=A+D is fixed before choosing a measure, with A actually ample and D effective rational Cartier on that same X. Approximation in the effective numerical cone, openness of ampleness, local factoriality, and numerical invariance of ampleness establish such a decomposition without Bertini, modifications, finite generation, or restrictions on field cardinality. Its mass is explicitly A^n, rather than an asserted class-independent volume.

The genuine-cone reconstruction survives scrutiny. Upward rounding operates within one defining FS net; its non-strict inequalities remain valid at common poles. Multiplication by generating sections embeds a tail into one actual ample bundle without changing the scalar functions. The finite-polytope transform produces actual section monomials, including at −∞ coordinates. The scaling-ray argument supplies the all-point homogeneous decomposition. Homogeneous division uses compactness of {σ_D=−1}, literal normal section division, and compactness only after embedding the divided functions into the normalized actual ample cone. It does not assert that those divided functions decrease. Divisorial determination then proves all-point equality. Finite maxima and ample compactness reconstruct the general dominated function. Consequently the entire genuinely defined cone is σ_D+PSH(A), with a uniquely determined actual quotient, including its extension across D.

This establishes compactness, order reflection, and relative envelopes on the original carrier. The reference is retained intrinsically through that unique quotient. The task expressly permits a prescribed singularity type; therefore omission of a minimal-singularity theorem does not itself invalidate the stated first target. No countability, toric, skeletal, support, or finite-generation restriction replaces the big-bundle domain.

The genuine-operator conclusion uses the additional argument in appendix117, not merely the manuscript's comparison of global approximants. On X with π=identity, its common ordinary neighborhood, actual ample H, fixed reference v=h0+p, compact outer strip, and eventual tails satisfy G0's retained contact-bridge hypotheses. The glued potentials have the same explicit global endpoint for independently supplied generated local nets. The indispensable identity is w=RΦ+Rh0+M+1; dropping Rh0 would give the wrong curvature. Continuous-stage local products, compact tests, and ample decreasing-net continuity establish independence of nets and collars. The supplied frame-change argument and common lower floors establish frame and generated-reference compatibility. This construction concerns exactly the stated generated category; it does not establish an unrestricted local-current density theorem.

The local metric sign is correct: h_L=h_A+log|f|. The resulting actual isometry on the reference complement precedes the operator's construction. The polar test also works: the capacity integral retains t^n, and α<1/(n+1) makes its tail integrable. G0 mixed integrability therefore removes the reference divisor and quotient pole sets. Strict-winning locality makes the restricted reference-floor measures increase. Their finite limit is Radon, and for finite-energy quotients it equals the genuine ample measure with raw mass A^n. Mixed products have mass (A1⋯An); arbitrary decreasing-net and integrable quotient-weighted limits follow with the test-containing pairing minus the zero-test pairing. No absolute integrability of σ_D is asserted or needed.

The energy is thereby justified by actual products before its identification with raw ample energy. The intrinsic target condition has exactly mass A^n and finite dual energy, equivalently integrability of every finite-energy quotient. Exclusion of mass on D is a consequence of that condition. Every original continuous two-sided outer variation retains the unique quotient. Ample coercivity, compactness by subnets, lower semicontinuity of J, target-integral continuity, and energy upper semicontinuity yield an attained maximizer that is an actual original function. Both Euler inequalities identify its already constructed operator with the target. Comparison, positive-mass domination, and all-point uniqueness modulo constants follow within this fixed reference cone.

The manuscript separately proves the actual trivial-bundle zero-mass case. Appendix118 additionally establishes, for every effective rational Cartier D, the entire full-divisor dominated cone as {σ_D+C}. Its application to the additional zero-volume domain is restricted to vol(O(D))=0. The divided FS classes tend to zero; refinement by a vanishing ample scale and finite divisorial evaluation bounds force every homogeneous component to equal σ_D at all points. Local unit-log curvature, reference floors, and nonpluripolar extension then give the zero operator and zero energy. The only positive target is μ=0; envelopes, all continuous derivatives, attainment, and uniqueness modulo constants are explicit. No probability normalization occurs. Dimension zero is correctly excluded. The usual positive-mass domination principle is not claimed in this zero-mass range.

The P1×P1 example correctly disproves unrestricted uniqueness for a general zero-volume datum. Its bounded potentials are outside the full-pole reference cone of appendix118, so it does not refute that extension. The abstract counterexample to BJ v4 Lemma4.6 is also valid: after a term with its isolated pole, a decreasing net cannot change families. The replacement proofs do not use that false general closure lemma or its nonample closure chain.

Two harmless clarifications are needed. In §3.4, forcing −∞ at a smaller ray parameter uses a still smaller auxiliary parameter and the finite uniform upper bound; the word 'larger' describes the wrong choice. In §5.2, an arbitrary usc obstacle may have an empty feasible cone: the envelope formula needs the usual −∞ convention, or an explicit nonemptiness qualification. The continuous obstacles and finite-energy variations used in the equation have minorants, so neither clarification changes the theorem.

What remains unproved is precise: (1) big-class equation theories for minimal-singularity or general model references beyond those with an actual ample residual bundle, including mass vol(L) in the minimal case; (2) an original-carrier theory for arbitrary nonbig pseudoeffective data, particularly those without a retained effective-divisor representation, with an appropriate intrinsic datum and uniqueness formulation; and (3) compatibility between different references if a class-intrinsic operator or an equation on all PSH(L) is claimed. Items (1) and (3) are broader than the explicit prescribed-reference first target. The supplied packet does not establish the unrestricted original axis.

Primary evidence was independently opened and checked in the pertinent statement/proof units: BJ v4 §§1–2 and Definition4.1, including Lemma2.23 at L1588–1612@P26; Fujino–Miyamoto v1 Theorem1.4 and its proof; Stacks01Q3, 0AG0, and 0BX5 with the pertinent valuative existence/uniqueness units; BE v3 §§7.12–7.14 and 8.3–8.5; and CLD v2 §§8.8.5 and 18.1.2. Whole primary works and every recursive algebraic, Berkovich, or Bedford–Taylor background proof were not read or re-proved. Historical coordinate systems are not interchanged. External premises occupy indices 0–8 below. Passages marked −1 document the task grant and its reference allowance; G0 is excluded from external premises and binds only the supplied actual-ample body, not the proposed appendices.

passages.statement: On a boundaryless analytic space over a complete non-Archimedean field, possibly trivially valued, logarithms of absolute values of invertible analytic functions are smooth with d′d′′=0. Adding these harmonic functions to continuous dpsh weights preserves their local mixed products with a positive closed current (CLD, arXiv:1204.6277v2, §§8.8.5 and 18.1.2).

On normal projective X over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, an FS function in a rational bundle B dominated by log||s_E||+O(1), for effective rational Cartier E, yields an actual FS quotient in B−E by section division after clearing powers (BJ, arXiv:1801.08229v4, Lemma2.23).

passages.statement: On an n-dimensional projective scheme over a complete valued field, possibly trivially valued, psh metrics on semiample rational bundles are psh-regularizable. Continuous psh-regularizable metrics have symmetric positive fundamental-cycle mixed curvature Radon measures of raw mass (L1⋯Ln), and uniform metric convergence gives weak measure convergence (BE, arXiv:1805.01016v3, §§7.12–7.14 and 8.3–8.5).
